# openwebui_subagents_config (Resource)

Manages the subagent settings for Open WebUI. Subagents let a chat delegate work to a nested agent run. Every attribute is required, because Open WebUI writes all seven settings on every update.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_subagents_config" "example" {
  enable_subagents             = true
  subagents_background_enabled = false
  subagents_max_concurrent     = 2
  subagents_max_async          = 1
  subagents_max_iterations     = 8
  subagents_max_output         = 4000
  subagents_system_prompt      = ""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enable_subagents` (Boolean) Whether subagents are available at all.
- `subagents_background_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a subagent may keep running in the background after the chat turn ends.
- `subagents_max_async` (Number) Maximum number of background subagents.
- `subagents_max_concurrent` (Number) Maximum number of subagents that run at the same time.
- `subagents_max_iterations` (Number) Maximum number of turns one subagent takes before it stops.
- `subagents_max_output` (Number) Maximum size in characters of the output a subagent returns to its caller.
- `subagents_system_prompt` (String) System prompt given to every subagent. An empty string leaves the built-in prompt in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier. Set by Open WebUI.
